checks.name: talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse
checks.code:
/-- The covariance difference in the Gaussian pressure derivative is averaged with one and two Gibbs replicas. -/
noncomputable def talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse {S : Type*} [Fintype S]
    (p : S → ℝ) (D : S → S → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i, p i * (D i i - ∑ j, p j * D j i)) / 2
checks.doc: The covariance difference in the Gaussian pressure derivative is averaged with one and two Gibbs replicas.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse_abs_le
checks.code:
/-- The two Gibbs averages each contribute at most the uniform covariance error; the factor one half cancels their sum. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse_abs_le {S : Type*} [Fintype S]
    (p : S → ℝ) (D : S → S → ℝ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) (hsum : ∑ i, p i = 1) (hD : ∀ i j, |D i j| ≤ ε) :
    |talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse p D| ≤ ε := by
  have havg (i : S) : |∑ j, p j * D j i| ≤ ε := by
    calc
      |∑ j, p j * D j i| ≤ ∑ j, |p j * D j i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j, p j * ε := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hp j)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hD j i) (hp j)
      _ = ε := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, one_mul]
  have htotal : |∑ i, p i * (D i i - ∑ j, p j * D j i)| ≤ 2 * ε := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, |p i * (D i i - ∑ j, p j * D j i)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i, p i * (2 * ε) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hp i)]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hp i)
        exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by linarith [hD i i, havg i])
      _ = 2 * ε := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, one_mul]
  unfold talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
  linarith
checks.doc: The two Gibbs averages each contribute at most the uniform covariance error; the factor one half cancels their sum.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_pressureComparison_of_interpolation
checks.code:
/-- A continuous pressure path with the Gaussian interpolation derivative has endpoint pressure difference at most the uniform covariance error. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_pressureComparison_of_interpolation {S Ω : Type*} [Fintype S]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (P : ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ → Ω → S → ℝ) (D : S → S → ℝ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hP : ContinuousOn P (Set.Icc 0 1))
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ω i, 0 ≤ p t ω i)
    (hsum : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ ω, ∑ i, p t ω i = 1)
    (hD : ∀ i j, |D i j| ≤ ε)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt P (∫ ω, talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse (p t ω) D ∂μ) t) :
    |P 1 - P 0| ≤ ε := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hslope⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope P
    (fun t => ∫ ω, talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse (p t ω) D ∂μ)
    (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num) hP hderiv
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ‖talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse (p t ω) D‖ ≤ ε :=
    Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse_abs_le (p t ω) D ε (hp t ht ω) (hsum t ht ω) hD
  have hint := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hbound
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, hslope, sub_zero, div_one, probReal_univ, mul_one] using hint
checks.doc: A continuous pressure path with the Gaussian interpolation derivative has endpoint pressure difference at most the uniform covariance error.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_covariance_error_triangle
checks.code:
/-- Two normalized covariance kernels satisfying (1.3) for the same overlap profile differ by at most the sum of their errors. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_covariance_error_triangle {S : Type*}
    (A B : S → S → ℝ) (R : S → S → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ → ℝ) (cA cB : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ σ τ, |A σ τ - ξ (R σ τ)| ≤ cA)
    (hB : ∀ σ τ, |B σ τ - ξ (R σ τ)| ≤ cB) :
    ∀ σ τ, |A σ τ - B σ τ| ≤ cA + cB := by
  intro σ τ
  exact (abs_sub_le (A σ τ) (ξ (R σ τ)) (B σ τ)).trans
    (add_le_add (hA σ τ) (by simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using hB σ τ))
checks.doc: Two normalized covariance kernels satisfying (1.3) for the same overlap profile differ by at most the sum of their errors.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_pressure_limit_transfer
checks.code:
/-- A vanishing pressure difference transfers a thermodynamic limit from the reference sequence. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_pressure_limit_transfer {P Q c : ℕ → ℝ} {L : ℝ}
    (hQ : Tendsto Q atTop (𝓝 L)) (hc : Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hclose : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, |P n - Q n| ≤ c n) : Tendsto P atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n => P n - Q n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    simp only [sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => abs_nonneg _) hclose hc
  simpa only [zero_add, sub_add_cancel] using hdiff.add hQ
checks.doc: A vanishing pressure difference transfers a thermodynamic limit from the reference sequence.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_pressure_density_limit_of_covariance_bounds
checks.code:
/-- A finite-volume pressure bound by the unnormalized covariance difference transfers the pressure density limit through (1.3) for a shared overlap profile. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_pressure_density_limit_of_covariance_bounds
    {S : ℕ → Type*} (A B R : (n : ℕ) → S n → S n → ℝ)
    (ξ : ℝ → ℝ) (P Q cA cB : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ n σ τ, |A n σ τ / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - ξ (R n σ τ)| ≤ cA n)
    (hB : ∀ n σ τ, |B n σ τ / ((n : ℝ) + 1) - ξ (R n σ τ)| ≤ cB n)
    (hcA : Tendsto cA atTop (𝓝 0)) (hcB : Tendsto cB atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hcompare : ∀ n ε, (∀ σ τ, |A n σ τ - B n σ τ| ≤ ε) → |P n - Q n| ≤ ε)
    (hQ : Tendsto (fun n => Q n / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => P n / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  have hc : Tendsto (fun n => cA n + cB n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using hcA.add hcB
  apply talagrandPaper_pressure_limit_transfer hQ hc
  filter_upwards with n
  have hn : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  have hclose (σ τ : S n) :
      |A n σ τ - B n σ τ| ≤ (cA n + cB n) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    have hz := talagrandPaper_covariance_error_triangle
      (fun σ τ => A n σ τ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) (fun σ τ => B n σ τ / ((n : ℝ) + 1))
      (R n) ξ (cA n) (cB n) (hA n) (hB n) σ τ
    rwa [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hn, div_le_iff₀ hn] at hz
  rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hn, div_le_iff₀ hn]
  exact hcompare n _ hclose
checks.doc: A finite-volume pressure bound by the unnormalized covariance difference transfers the pressure density limit through (1.3) for a shared overlap profile.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_gaussianPressure
checks.code:
/-- The expected log-partition function of a finite centered Gaussian field represented by coefficient vectors, with deterministic potential `V`. -/
noncomputable def talagrandPaper_gaussianPressure {S I : Type*} [Fintype S] [Fintype I]
    (V : S → ℝ) (A : S → EuclideanSpace ℝ I) : ℝ :=
  ∫ z, gtStateLogPartition V (gtCoefficientCLM A (WithLp.toLp 2 z))
    ∂Measure.pi (fun _ : I => gaussianReal 0 1)
checks.doc: The expected log-partition function of a finite centered Gaussian field represented by coefficient vectors, with deterministic potential `V`.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_gaussian_pressure_abs_sub_le
checks.code:
/-- Entrywise closeness of the two Gram covariance kernels bounds the difference of the expected log-partition functions by the same error. Orthogonal coefficient spans put independent endpoint fields on one Gaussian space. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_gaussian_pressure_abs_sub_le
    {S I : Type*} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S] [Fintype I]
    (V : S → ℝ) (A B : S → EuclideanSpace ℝ I) (ε : ℝ)
    (hAB : ∀ i j, inner ℝ (A i) (B j) = 0)
    (hD : ∀ i j, |inner ℝ (A i) (A j) - inner ℝ (B i) (B j)| ≤ ε) :
    |talagrandPaper_gaussianPressure V A - talagrandPaper_gaussianPressure V B| ≤ ε := by
  let μ := Measure.pi (fun _ : I => gaussianReal 0 1)
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := by dsimp [μ]; infer_instance
  let p (t : ℝ) (z : I → ℝ) (i : S) :=
    gtStateGibbs V (gtOrdinaryField A B 0 t (WithLp.toLp 2 z)) i
  let D (i j : S) := inner ℝ (A i) (A j) - inner ℝ (B i) (B j)
  have hcomparison := talagrandPaper_pressureComparison_of_interpolation μ
    (gtOrdinaryPressure V A B 0) p D ε
    (continuous_gtOrdinaryPressure V A B 0).continuousOn
    (fun t _ z i => gtStateGibbs_nonneg V _ i)
    (fun t _ z => sum_gtStateGibbs V _) hD
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
      HasDerivAt (gtOrdinaryPressure V A B 0)
        (∫ z, talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse (p t z) D ∂μ) t := by
    let fA (i : S) (z : I → ℝ) :=
      gtOrdinaryCovarianceTerm V A B A 0 t i (WithLp.toLp 2 z)
    let fB (i : S) (z : I → ℝ) :=
      gtOrdinaryCovarianceTerm V A B B 0 t i (WithLp.toLp 2 z)
    have hiA (i : S) : Integrable (fA i) μ := integrable_gtOrdinaryCovarianceTerm V A B A 0 t i
    have hiB (i : S) : Integrable (fB i) μ := integrable_gtOrdinaryCovarianceTerm V A B B 0 t i
    have hpoint (z : I → ℝ) : talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse (p t z) D =
        ∑ i, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (fA i z - fB i z) := by
      rw [talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm _ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹,
        one_div, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      dsimp only [D, fA, fB, p, gtOrdinaryCovarianceTerm]
      simp_rw [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      ring
    have hformula : (∫ z, talagrandPaper_covarianceResponse (p t z) D ∂μ) =
        ∑ i, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((∫ z, fA i z ∂μ) - ∫ z, fB i z ∂μ) := by
      simp_rw [hpoint]
      rw [integral_finsetSum]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub (hiA i) (hiB i)]
      · exact fun i _ => ((hiA i).sub (hiB i)).const_mul _
    rw [hformula]
    exact hasDerivAt_gtOrdinaryPressure_ibp V A B 0 hAB ht
  simpa [gtOrdinaryPressure, gtOrdinaryField, talagrandPaper_gaussianPressure] using
    hcomparison hderiv
checks.doc: Entrywise closeness of the two Gram covariance kernels bounds the difference of the expected log-partition functions by the same error. Orthogonal coefficient spans put independent endpoint fields on one Gaussian space.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_pressure_limit_of_covariance_approximation
checks.code:
/-- Two Gaussian Hamiltonian sequences on orthogonal coefficient spans have the same normalized pressure limit when both satisfy (1.3) for the same overlap profile (1.4) and one sequence has a limit. The positive system sizes are `n + 1`. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_pressure_limit_of_covariance_approximation
    {I : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, Fintype (I n)] (ξ : ℝ → ℝ) (h : ℝ)
    (A B : (n : ℕ) → SpinGlass.Config (n + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (I n))
    (cA cB : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ)
    (hAB : ∀ n σ τ, inner ℝ (A n σ) (B n τ) = 0)
    (hA : ∀ n σ τ, |inner ℝ (A n σ) (A n τ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) -
      ξ (SpinGlass.overlap (n + 1) σ τ)| ≤ cA n)
    (hB : ∀ n σ τ, |inner ℝ (B n σ) (B n τ) / ((n : ℝ) + 1) -
      ξ (SpinGlass.overlap (n + 1) σ τ)| ≤ cB n)
    (hcA : Tendsto cA atTop (𝓝 0)) (hcB : Tendsto cB atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hBlim : Tendsto (fun n => talagrandPaper_gaussianPressure
      (fun σ => h * SpinGlass.magnetization (n + 1) σ) (B n) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 L)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => talagrandPaper_gaussianPressure
      (fun σ => h * SpinGlass.magnetization (n + 1) σ) (A n) / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
  refine talagrandPaper_pressure_density_limit_of_covariance_bounds
    (fun n σ τ => inner ℝ (A n σ) (A n τ)) (fun n σ τ => inner ℝ (B n σ) (B n τ))
    (fun n => SpinGlass.overlap (n + 1)) ξ _ _ cA cB L hA hB hcA hcB ?_ hBlim
  intro n ε hn
  exact talagrandPaper_gaussian_pressure_abs_sub_le
    (fun σ => h * SpinGlass.magnetization (n + 1) σ) (A n) (B n) ε (hAB n) hn
checks.doc: Two Gaussian Hamiltonian sequences on orthogonal coefficient spans have the same normalized pressure limit when both satisfy (1.3) for the same overlap profile (1.4) and one sequence has a limit. The positive system sizes are `n + 1`.

/-- The overlap of two configurations, as defined in (1.4). -/
noncomputable def talagrandPaper_overlap {n : ℕ} (σ τ : Fin n → Bool) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i, talagrandPaper_spin σ i * talagrandPaper_spin τ i) / (n : ℝ)

checks.name: talagrandPaper_originalSK
checks.code:
/-- Talagrand's SK Hamiltonian (1.1), with one disorder variable per edge. -/
noncomputable def talagrandPaper_originalSK {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type*} (β : ℝ)
    (g : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n → Ω → ℝ) (σ : Fin n → Bool) (ω : Ω) : ℝ :=
  (-β / Real.sqrt n) *
    ∑ p, (talagrandPaper_spin σ p.1.1 * talagrandPaper_spin σ p.1.2) * g p ω
checks.doc: Talagrand's SK Hamiltonian (1.1), with one disorder variable per edge.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_overlap_square
checks.code:
/-- Squaring the overlap numerator counts every unordered pair twice and every diagonal once. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_overlap_square {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, a i ^ 2 = 1) :
    (∑ i, a i) ^ 2 =
      2 * (∑ p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n, a p.1.1 * a p.1.2) + (n : ℝ) := by
  classical
  have upper :
      (∑ p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n, a p.1.1 * a p.1.2) =
        ∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.1 < p.2 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    exact (Finset.sum_subtype
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin n × Fin n => p.1 < p.2)
      (p := fun p => p.1 < p.2) (by simp) (fun p => a p.1 * a p.2)).symm
  have diagonal :
      (∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.1 = p.2 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0) = (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp [← pow_two, ha]
  have lower :
      (∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.2 < p.1 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0) =
        ∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.1 < p.2 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.1 < p.2 then a p.2 * a p.1 else 0 :=
        ((Equiv.prodComm (Fin n) (Fin n)).sum_comp
          (fun p => if p.2 < p.1 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0)).symm
      _ = _ := by simp only [mul_comm]
  calc
    (∑ i, a i) ^ 2 = ∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, a p.1 * a p.2 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, pow_two, Finset.sum_mul]
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ =
        (∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.1 < p.2 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0) +
        (∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.2 < p.1 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0) +
        (∑ p : Fin n × Fin n, if p.1 = p.2 then a p.1 * a p.2 else 0) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
      rcases lt_trichotomy p.1 p.2 with h | h | h
      · simp [h, h.ne, h.not_gt]
      · simp [h]
      · simp [h, h.ne.symm, h.not_gt]
    _ = _ := by rw [lower, ← upper, diagonal]; ring
checks.doc: Squaring the overlap numerator counts every unordered pair twice and every diagonal once.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_originalSK_covariance
checks.code:
/-- The covariance of (1.1) depends only on the covariance matrix of the edge variables. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_originalSK_covariance {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (β : ℝ)
    (g : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hgLp : ∀ p, MemLp (g p) 2 μ)
    (hgCov : ∀ p q, cov[g p, g q; μ] = if p = q then 1 else 0)
    (σ τ : Fin n → Bool) :
    cov[talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ, talagrandPaper_originalSK β g τ; μ] =
      (n : ℝ) * (β ^ 2 * talagrandPaper_overlap σ τ ^ 2 / 2) - β ^ 2 / 2 := by
  classical
  let a (i : Fin n) : ℝ := talagrandPaper_spin σ i * talagrandPaper_spin τ i
  have ha (i : Fin n) : a i ^ 2 = 1 := by
    cases hσ : σ i <;> cases hτ : τ i <;> norm_num [a, talagrandPaper_spin, hσ, hτ]
  let f (ρ : Fin n → Bool) (p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n) : ℝ :=
    talagrandPaper_spin ρ p.1.1 * talagrandPaper_spin ρ p.1.2
  have hLp (ρ : Fin n → Bool) (p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n) :
      MemLp (fun ω => f ρ p * g p ω) 2 μ := (hgLp p).const_mul _
  have hsum :
      (∑ p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n,
        ∑ q : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n,
          cov[(fun ω => f σ p * g p ω), (fun ω => f τ q * g q ω); μ]) =
        ∑ p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n, a p.1.1 * a p.1.2 := by
    simp only [covariance_const_mul_left, covariance_const_mul_right, hgCov]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    calc
      _ = ∑ q : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n, if p = q then f σ p * f τ p else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
        by_cases hpq : p = q
        · subst q
          simp [mul_comm]
        · simp [hpq]
      _ = _ := by simp [f, a]; ring
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) ^ 2 = (n : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  have hscale : (-β / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) * (-β / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) =
      β ^ 2 / (n : ℝ) := by
    rw [← pow_two, div_pow, neg_sq, hsqrt]
  change cov[
    (fun ω => (-β / Real.sqrt n) * ∑ p, f σ p * g p ω),
    (fun ω => (-β / Real.sqrt n) * ∑ p, f τ p * g p ω); μ] = _
  rw [covariance_const_mul_left, covariance_const_mul_right,
    covariance_fun_sum_fun_sum (hLp σ) (hLp τ), hsum, ← mul_assoc, hscale]
  have hupper :
      (∑ p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n, a p.1.1 * a p.1.2) =
        ((∑ i, a i) ^ 2 - (n : ℝ)) / 2 := by
    linarith [talagrandPaper_overlap_square a ha]
  rw [hupper]
  change β ^ 2 / (n : ℝ) * (((∑ i, a i) ^ 2 - (n : ℝ)) / 2) =
    (n : ℝ) * (β ^ 2 * ((∑ i, a i) / (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 / 2) - β ^ 2 / 2
  field_simp [hn']
checks.doc: The covariance of (1.1) depends only on the covariance matrix of the edge variables.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp
checks.code:
/-- A real Gaussian random variable has finite moments at each finite exponent. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {m : ℝ} {v : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasLaw X (gaussianReal m v) μ) {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : p ≠ ∞) :
    MemLp X p μ := by
  have hG := memLp_id_gaussianReal' (μ := m) (v := v) p hp
  rw [← hX.map_eq] at hG
  simpa only [Function.id_comp] using hG.comp_of_map hX.aemeasurable
checks.doc: A real Gaussian random variable has finite moments at each finite exponent.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_originalSK_memLp
checks.code:
/-- Square-integrable edge variables give a square-integrable SK energy at every configuration. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_originalSK_memLp {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} (β : ℝ)
    (g : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ p, MemLp (g p) 2 μ) (σ : Fin n → Bool) :
    MemLp (talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ) 2 μ := by
  unfold talagrandPaper_originalSK
  apply MemLp.const_mul
  exact memLp_finsetSum _ (fun p _ => (hg p).const_mul _)
checks.doc: Square-integrable edge variables give a square-integrable SK energy at every configuration.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_mean_zero
checks.code:
/-- Centered Gaussian edge variables make the Hamiltonian (1.1) centered. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_mean_zero {n : ℕ} {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} (β : ℝ)
    (g : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n → Ω → ℝ)
    (hlaw : ∀ p, HasLaw (g p) (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) (σ : Fin n → Bool) :
    (∫ ω, talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ ω ∂μ) = 0 := by
  let f (p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n) (ω : Ω) :=
    (talagrandPaper_spin σ p.1.1 * talagrandPaper_spin σ p.1.2) * g p ω
  have hLp (p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n) : Integrable (f p) μ :=
    (memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
      (talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp (hlaw p) (by norm_num))).const_mul _
  have hMean (p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n) : (∫ ω, g p ω ∂μ) = 0 :=
    (hlaw p).integral_eq.trans integral_id_gaussianReal
  change (∫ ω, (-β / Real.sqrt n) * ∑ p, f p ω ∂μ) = 0
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum _ (fun p _ => hLp p)]
  simp [f, integral_const_mul, hMean]
checks.doc: Centered Gaussian edge variables make the Hamiltonian (1.1) centered.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_covariance
checks.code:
/-- Independent standard Gaussian edge variables in (1.1) have the stated covariance defect. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_covariance {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (β : ℝ)
    (g : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n → Ω → ℝ) (hg : iIndepFun g μ)
    (hlaw : ∀ p, HasLaw (g p) (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) (σ τ : Fin n → Bool) :
    cov[talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ, talagrandPaper_originalSK β g τ; μ] =
      (n : ℝ) * (β ^ 2 * talagrandPaper_overlap σ τ ^ 2 / 2) - β ^ 2 / 2 := by
  have hLp (p : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n) : MemLp (g p) 2 μ :=
    talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp (hlaw p) (by norm_num)
  apply talagrandPaper_originalSK_covariance hn β g hLp _ σ τ
  intro p q
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl, covariance_self (hlaw p).aemeasurable, (hlaw p).variance_eq,
      variance_id_gaussianReal]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hpq]
    exact (hg.indepFun hpq).covariance_eq_zero (hLp p) (hLp q)
checks.doc: Independent standard Gaussian edge variables in (1.1) have the stated covariance defect.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_covariance_error
checks.code:
/-- The exact uniform covariance error in (1.3) for the original SK normalization. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_covariance_error {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (β : ℝ)
    (g : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n → Ω → ℝ) (hg : iIndepFun g μ)
    (hlaw : ∀ p, HasLaw (g p) (gaussianReal 0 1) μ) (σ τ : Fin n → Bool) :
    |(∫ ω, talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ ω * talagrandPaper_originalSK β g τ ω ∂μ) /
        (n : ℝ) - β ^ 2 * talagrandPaper_overlap σ τ ^ 2 / 2| =
      β ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ)) := by
  have hLp (ρ : Fin n → Bool) : MemLp (talagrandPaper_originalSK β g ρ) 2 μ :=
    talagrandPaper_originalSK_memLp β g
      (fun p => talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp (hlaw p) (by norm_num)) ρ
  have hCov :
      cov[talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ, talagrandPaper_originalSK β g τ; μ] =
        ∫ ω, talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ ω * talagrandPaper_originalSK β g τ ω ∂μ := by
    rw [covariance_eq_sub (hLp σ) (hLp τ), talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_mean_zero β g hlaw σ]
    simp
  rw [← hCov, talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_covariance hn β g hg hlaw]
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hneg :
      ((n : ℝ) * (β ^ 2 * talagrandPaper_overlap σ τ ^ 2 / 2) - β ^ 2 / 2) / (n : ℝ) -
          β ^ 2 * talagrandPaper_overlap σ τ ^ 2 / 2 = -(β ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ))) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hn']
    ring
  have herror : 0 ≤ β ^ 2 / (2 * (n : ℝ)) := by positivity
  rw [hneg, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg herror]
checks.doc: The exact uniform covariance error in (1.3) for the original SK normalization.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_shifted_covariance
checks.code:
/-- Adding a common Gaussian of variance β²/2, independent of each Hamiltonian coordinate,
turns the covariance in (1.1) into the exact quadratic kernel. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_shifted_covariance {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {Ω : Type*}
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (β : ℝ)
    (g : TalagrandPaperSKEdge n → Ω → ℝ) (hg : iIndepFun g μ)
    (hlaw : ∀ p, HasLaw (g p) (gaussianReal 0 1) μ)
    (z : Ω → ℝ) (hz : HasLaw z (gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (β ^ 2 / 2))) μ)
    (hind : ∀ ρ, IndepFun (talagrandPaper_originalSK β g ρ) z μ) (σ τ : Fin n → Bool) :
    cov[(fun ω => talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ ω + z ω),
      (fun ω => talagrandPaper_originalSK β g τ ω + z ω); μ] =
      (n : ℝ) * (β ^ 2 * talagrandPaper_overlap σ τ ^ 2 / 2) := by
  let X (ρ : Fin n → Bool) := talagrandPaper_originalSK β g ρ
  have hX (ρ : Fin n → Bool) : MemLp (X ρ) 2 μ :=
    talagrandPaper_originalSK_memLp β g
      (fun p => talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp (hlaw p) (by norm_num)) ρ
  have hZ : MemLp z 2 μ := talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp hz (by norm_num)
  have hXZ (ρ : Fin n → Bool) : cov[X ρ, z; μ] = 0 :=
    (hind ρ).covariance_eq_zero (hX ρ) hZ
  have hZX (ρ : Fin n → Bool) : cov[z, X ρ; μ] = 0 :=
    (covariance_comm z (X ρ)).trans (hXZ ρ)
  have hZZ : cov[z, z; μ] = β ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [covariance_self hz.aemeasurable, hz.variance_eq, variance_id_gaussianReal]
    have hvar : 0 ≤ β ^ 2 / 2 := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg β) (by norm_num)
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal', max_eq_left hvar]
  change cov[X σ + z, X τ + z; μ] = _
  rw [covariance_add_left (hX σ) hZ ((hX τ).add hZ),
    covariance_add_right (hX σ) (hX τ) hZ, covariance_add_right hZ (hX τ) hZ,
    hXZ, hZX, hZZ]
  change
    cov[talagrandPaper_originalSK β g σ, talagrandPaper_originalSK β g τ; μ] + 0 +
      (0 + β ^ 2 / 2) = _
  rw [talagrandPaper_gaussianSK_covariance hn β g hg hlaw]
  ring
checks.doc: Adding a common Gaussian of variance β²/2, independent of each Hamiltonian coordinate, turns the covariance in (1.1) into the exact quadratic kernel.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_log_partition_shift
checks.code:
/-- A common shift adds exactly that shift to the log partition function in (1.14). -/
theorem talagrandPaper_log_partition_shift {S : Type*} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
    (u : S → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    Real.log (∑ σ, Real.exp (u σ + c)) = Real.log (∑ σ, Real.exp (u σ)) + c := by
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ σ, Real.exp (u σ) :=
    Finset.sum_pos (fun σ _ => Real.exp_pos (u σ)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  simp_rw [Real.exp_add, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Real.log_mul hpos.ne' (Real.exp_ne_zero c), Real.log_exp]
checks.doc: A common shift adds exactly that shift to the log partition function in (1.14).

checks.name: talagrandPaper_expected_log_partition_shift
checks.code:
/-- A centered Gaussian common shift preserves the expected log partition function.
The energy here can include the external field of (1.14). -/
theorem talagrandPaper_expected_log_partition_shift {S : Type*} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} (β : ℝ)
    (u : S → Ω → ℝ) (z : Ω → ℝ)
    (hz : HasLaw z (gaussianReal 0 (Real.toNNReal (β ^ 2 / 2))) μ)
    (hu : Integrable (fun ω => Real.log (∑ σ, Real.exp (u σ ω))) μ) :
    (∫ ω, Real.log (∑ σ, Real.exp (u σ ω + z ω)) ∂μ) =
      ∫ ω, Real.log (∑ σ, Real.exp (u σ ω)) ∂μ := by
  have hZ : Integrable z μ := memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp (talagrandPaper_gaussian_memLp hz (by norm_num))
  have hZ0 : ∫ ω, z ω ∂μ = 0 := hz.integral_eq.trans integral_id_gaussianReal
  simp_rw [talagrandPaper_log_partition_shift]
  rw [integral_add hu hZ, hZ0, add_zero]
checks.doc: A centered Gaussian common shift preserves the expected log partition function. The energy here can include the external field of (1.14).

checks.name: talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator_eq
checks.code:
/-- The overlap numerator is twice the number of agreements minus the number of sites. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator_eq (sites : List (Bool × Bool)) :
    talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator sites =
      2 * (sites.countP fun site => site.1 == site.2 : Int) - (sites.length : Int) := by
  induction sites with
  | nil => decide
  | cons site sites ih =>
    change talagrandPaper_siteSpinProduct site + talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator sites = _
    rw [ih, List.countP_cons, List.length_cons]
    unfold talagrandPaper_siteSpinProduct
    split <;> omega
checks.doc: The overlap numerator is twice the number of agreements minus the number of sites.

checks.name: talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator_grid
checks.code:
/-- Two configurations on n sites have an overlap numerator of the form 2j − n for 0 ≤ j ≤ n. -/
theorem talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator_grid {n : Nat} (σ τ : Fin n → Bool) :
    ∃ j : Fin (n + 1),
      talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator (List.ofFn fun i => (σ i, τ i)) =
        2 * (j.val : Int) - (n : Int) := by
  let sites := List.ofFn fun i => (σ i, τ i)
  let agreements := sites.countP fun site => site.1 == site.2
  have hlength : sites.length = n := List.length_ofFn
  have hbound : agreements ≤ n := hlength ▸ List.countP_le_length
  refine ⟨⟨agreements, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hbound⟩, ?_⟩
  change talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator sites = 2 * (agreements : Int) - (n : Int)
  simpa only [hlength] using talagrandPaper_overlapNumerator_eq sites
checks.doc: Two configurations on n sites have an overlap numerator of the form 2j − n for 0 ≤ j ≤ n.
